decision: Worthwhile bounded source/assay pilot; shelve numerical execution and scientific promotion at current unresolved gate
why_question_remains: Native non-fusion mature intron retention by partner is distinct from existing gene expression and engineered splicing. This review establishes no IR outcome.
strongest_defeat: Run-to-authenticated-native-case/partner/specimen linkage and primary library recipes are unresolved; even linked intronic coverage can represent nascent RNA/FFPE/capture rather than mature retained RNA. Published morphology/growth, composition and preparation alternatives remain.
prior_art_value: EMC EWS/NOR1 splicing activity already published. A new result must show a reproducible native phenotype with useful discrimination and adequate independent EMC support, not a generic splicing claim or selected-gene catalogue.
next_measurement_if_robust: For pre-specified replicated candidate events, measure both exon-intron and exon-exon boundaries in molecularly authenticated native EMC using orthogonal RT-PCR/targeted sequencing of mature polyadenylated RNA with DNase/no-RT and nuclear/cytoplasmic or nascent-RNA controls. Pair FFPE/frozen preparations and comparable libraries where obtainable. Additional native donors test partner association; only controlled perturbation and rescue could test causal fusion effects.
reopen_conditions: Exact individual case/partner/specimen/run map and paired-condition accountability
Primary ref22/ref3 assay recipes plus source-calibrated intronic/spliced coverage capable of resolving intended native endpoint
All relevant suitable accessible EMC contexts evaluated with controls and prior-art reassessment
A discriminating result beyond known expression/growth that directs and survives an informative orthogonal next measurement
limits: Partner correlation is not causal splicing, a tumor-cell origin claim or a treatment dependency. A negative gated measurement is not absence of all RNA-processing biology.
